title: Known-object test, TOI-224.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-224.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 10, 8, —, 4.5, —; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth none on grid, none on grid, 2%, 2%, none on grid (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 24 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 5 light curve(s), forming 4 distinct event(s), 4 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2459092.1803 (ΔT 726.34 d); 18 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
